definitions.run: one recorded CLI invocation of one case; no fabricated group run IDs
definitions.tasks: root cases (1 per completed invocation), not recursive subtasks
definitions.allocation: root award compared with precommitted gold
definitions.messages: all depths: propose call_start + valid bid=true proposal + award
definitions.excluded_messages: review, execution, synthesis, refusals, invalid proposals and HTTP retries
definitions.failure: all five count columns blank; partial observations retained only in note/evidence
definitions.report_blocks: CSV completed-row sums by original block and condition; one result per original slot
definitions.recovery: user-requested final-slot estimate includes 429 recovery; original failed attempts remain blank rows
